abstract: Granulosa cell tumors are classified as juvenile and adult types. They may be misinterpreted as a yolk sac tumor when they exhibit a "reticular" growth pattern and contain prominent mitotic activity. In this study, the authors performed immunohistochemical stains for SALL4 and steroidogenic factor-1 (SF-1) on 27 cases of yolk sac tumors and 24 granulosa cell tumors. Nuclear stains for both antibodies were considered as positive and the intensity of staining was graded as negative, weak, moderate, and strong. All the yolk sac tumors were positive for SALL4 (100%) with moderate to strong grade staining and negative for SF-1 (100%). In contrast, all the granulosa cell tumors were positive for SF-1 (85% moderate to strong grade staining and 15% weak staining) and negative for SALL4 (100%). The difference was significant (P < .01, Student's t test). This result indicates that these 2 markers could be used to distinguish these 2 tumors in a difficult situation.
abstract_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫瘍は若年型と成人型に分類される。「網状」の増殖パターンを示し有糸分裂活性が高い場合には、卵黄嚢腫瘍と誤診されることがある。本研究では、卵黄嚢腫瘍27例と顆粒膜細胞腫瘍24例に対し、SALL4とステロイド産生因子1（SF-1）の免疫組織化学染色を行った。両抗体の核染色を陽性とみなし、染色強度を陰性、弱、中等度、強に分類した。卵黄嚢腫瘍はすべてSALL4陽性（100%、中等度から強染色）でSF-1陰性（100%）であった。一方、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍はすべてSF-1陽性（中等度から強染色85%、弱染色15%）でSALL4陰性（100%）であった。この差は有意であった（P<.01、Student's t検定）。この結果から、これら2つのマーカーは判断が難しい場合に両腫瘍を区別するために用いられることが示された。
